## [Configure Mureka API account](https://useapi.net/docs/api-mureka-v1/post-mureka-accounts)

Two ways to connect — send **one** body.

**Email + password (recommended):** `{ "email", "password" }`. The API stores the password and logs back in automatically whenever Mureka ends the session — no manual re-linking. Create a dedicated Mureka account with email + password via the guided setup page. Reports `authMode: "email"`.

**Session token:** `{ "token", "refresh_token" }` copied from Mureka at sign-in. `refresh_token` is optional but recommended (omit it for a token-only account: ~30 days, no auto-refresh, then re-link). Reports `authMode: "token"`.
